storyboard.title: A new setup stage: the caption lands
storyboard.trigger: The setup document reports a new stage (choosing, awaiting-ready, running).

storyboard.title: The role card is dealt, face down
storyboard.trigger: This seat’s own setup preview first arrives for the current deal. Not after a reload or a recovery.

storyboard.title: The card is turned up and the device added (private)
storyboard.trigger: The player presses Reveal my role. Local; inside the private container only.

storyboard.title: A command is registered: stamp in the private card
storyboard.trigger: The server’s receipt accepts this seat’s command. Never a public cue.

storyboard.title: A piece is carried to its new room
storyboard.trigger: A public location change in the view (PUBLIC_MOVE); the same on every screen.

storyboard.title: A new phase: the words slide in
storyboard.trigger: The view reports a new phase (PHASE_CHANGED).

storyboard.title: A new round: the ink band sweeps under the strip
storyboard.trigger: The view reports a new round.

storyboard.title: Host: a request to join drops in
storyboard.trigger: A new pending admission appears in the host’s list.

storyboard.title: Selection: the character was just taken
storyboard.trigger: The server refuses the choice (CHARACTER_TAKEN) and the identity document shows the holder.

storyboard.title: The result arrives as a comic cover
storyboard.trigger: The view first carries a finished or aborted match.
